description: Spot price, 24h change, market cap and 24h volume for up to 50 tokens, via CoinGecko. Use CoinGecko ids such as 'bitcoin' or 'ethereum', not exchange tickers. Works without an API key.

ids.description: CoinGecko id(s), comma-separated, up to 50. E.g. 'bitcoin,ethereum'.
